reason: A prompt optimization utility that converts informal instructions into structured prompts through the harness LLM service, with optional context use, agent and service interfaces, composer integration, caching, and opt-in automatic message rewriting.

summaries.zh: 将自然语言指令优化为结构化提示词，并通过智能体工具、服务接口或输入框按钮提供可选的上下文感知和自动优化功能。
summaries.en: Transforms informal instructions into structured prompts through agent, service, and composer interfaces, with optional context awareness and automatic optimization.

capabilities: Rewrites user instructions into structured prompts using the harness LLM service
Provides an agent-callable optimization tool and programmable service
Can optionally optimize messages automatically before model execution
Provides a browser composer control that replaces the current draft with an optimized prompt
Uses recent conversation context when enabled
